lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.focus: measuring lengths to the nearest half and quarter inch
lessonRef.title: Concept build C: measuring lengths to the nearest half and quarter inch

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: A line plot shows 5 pencil lengths to the nearest 1/2 inch: 1/2, 1/2, 1, 1, 3/2. How many pencils measured exactly 1/2 inch?

steps: Two of the recorded lengths are 1/2 inch.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching adult. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 1/4, 1/4, 2/4, 4/4, 4/4, 3/4, 4/4, 1/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 3/4, 2/4, 3/4, 3/4, 1/4, 2/4, 1/4, 2/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 8/8, 7/8, 3/8, 8/8, 5/8, 5/8, 2/8, 4/8. How many leaves measured exactly 2/8 inch?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 4/4, 1/4, 4/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 2/4, 4/4. How many leaves measured exactly 4/4 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 5/8, 3/8, 4/8, 5/8, 2/8, 8/8, 5/8, 1/8. How many leaves measured exactly 1/8 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 6/8, 2/8, 5/8, 1/8, 6/8, 7/8, 4/8, 5/8. How many leaves measured exactly 7/8 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 8/8, 1/8, 8/8, 2/8, 6/8, 2/8, 3/8, 1/8. How many leaves measured exactly 2/8 inch?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/4 inch: 1/4, 2/4, 1/4, 3/4, 3/4, 1/4, 1/4, 4/4. How many leaves measured exactly 1/4 inch?
A line plot shows the lengths of 8 leaves, each measured to the nearest 1/8 inch: 2/8, 1/8, 1/8, 8/8, 5/8, 4/8, 4/8, 6/8. How many leaves measured exactly 6/8 inch?
